common_prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create ONE square canonical Strength Ledger movement photograph for mobile cards and exact movement history. INPUT 1 is the approved ORIGINAL Incline Dumbbell Bench Press and the immutable, sole visual style control. Preserve its premium near-black studio, dark subtly textured floor, natural muscular adult athlete in graphite sleeveless shirt, black shorts and plain black shoes, believable skin/fabric, neutral brushed-silver equipment, broad neutral key and restrained violet rear-right rim. Same commercial fitness photography and normal-to-short-telephoto lens feel. Movement mechanics dictate a new camera/pose; do not copy the incline press pose. No new blue palette, fog, neon, shirtless posing, branding, text, numbers, watermarks, anatomy highlights or gym clutter. One athlete only, natural proportions, neutral focused expression, two anatomically plausible hands with wrapped grips, physically coherent implements and support/contact shadows. Fit the WHOLE athlete, both complete shoes, all weights/bar ends and bench/support feet within the square with about 8% breathing room; action occupies roughly 80–85% of longest image axis, not a tiny figure. Never cut off or merge equipment. Preserve full photographic detail and strong implement/torso/arm silhouette for downscaling.

movements.cue: DUMBBELL CURL. Standing muscular adult athlete, feet hip width, upright quiet torso. BOTH elbows fixed beside ribs, both forearms curled to roughly horizontal/upward with palms SUPINATED toward shoulders. TWO matching brushed-silver dumbbells, fingers wrapped around separate continuous handles, wrists straight. Front three-quarter camera exposes palm-up grips and biceps elbow flexion; no shoulder press or hammer-neutral grip. Whole body and shoes.

BARBELL WRIST CURL. Seated on a plain flat black bench, knees apart, torso leaning slightly forward. BOTH forearms rest palm-up along thighs with wrists just beyond kneecaps. Narrow supinated grip on a light straight silver barbell just in front of knees; wrists visibly curl the bar UP toward the forearms while elbows/forearms stay supported. Hands close enough inside knees, both palms facing up. Modest small symmetrical plates, shaft straight. Full side-front three-quarter view, camera close enough to clearly read forearm support and flexed wrists, entire seated athlete and bench in frame.

BULGARIAN SPLIT SQUAT, quad-focused bottom position. One rear foot rests shoelaces DOWN on a stable flat black bench behind athlete, rear knee lowered toward floor without touching. Front foot flat, front knee flexed roughly 90 degrees tracking over toes, torso mostly upright, front thigh near horizontal. One silver dumbbell held in each straight arm beside hips. Three-quarter SIDE camera clearly exposes long split stance, rear-foot elevation, full front foot and bench contact. Two legs only; no back-foot float or crossed feet, all bench feet visible.

DUMBBELL ROMANIAN DEADLIFT at controlled deep hip-hinge bottom. Athlete stands on BOTH flat feet hip-width, knees softly bent about 15-20 degrees, hips pushed BACK, neutral long flat spine and torso near horizontal. TWO matching silver dumbbells hang from straight arms very close to front/sides of shins, mid-shin height ABOVE floor. Head follows spine looking down-forward. True side three-quarter camera makes hip hinge and slight knee bend unmistakable; not a squat, lunge, row or one-leg balance. Full feet and both complete dumbbells.

movements.implement: Two dumbbells and low calf platform
movements.cue: STANDING DUMBBELL CALF RAISE at top plantarflexion. Upright athlete holds one silver dumbbell in each straight arm at sides. BOTH forefeet/balls of feet supported on front edge of one low stable black rectangular calf step, both HEELS clearly lifted high above toes, knees straight but not locked, ankles extended. Side three-quarter camera exposes raised heels and toes pressing into step. No hopping; contact of both forefeet is visible, whole platform and both shoes in frame. No machine or rack.

WEIGHTED CRUNCH on dark floor. Athlete lies supine on thin dark mat, knees bent about90 degrees and BOTH feet planted on floor. Lower back and pelvis stay grounded. Shoulder blades curled just off floor, ribs draw toward pelvis; torso only about20-25 degrees off floor, NOT a full sit-up. BOTH hands hug one modest silver weight plate flat against upper chest. Neck neutral with small chin tuck, elbows relaxed. Elevated side three-quarter view shows short trunk-flexion arc and complete body/mat; plate supported by hands never resting on throat.

BARBELL CURL. Standing athlete with quiet upright torso and knees softly extended, shoulder-width supinated grip on a perfectly STRAIGHT silver barbell, equal modest round plates at ends. Both elbows tucked next to ribs, forearms mid-curl slightly above horizontal; wrists neutral and palms toward ceiling. No EZ zigzag shaft. Front three-quarter view exposes both grips and complete straight continuous bar, whole body and shoes.

EZ BAR CURL. Standing athlete, torso upright, elbows at sides, both forearms mid-curl near horizontal. Both hands use the inner angled portions of a clearly and symmetrically zigzag EZ curl bar, semi-supinated wrists. Equal modest brushed-metal round plates at both ends. Front three-quarter view clearly distinguishes angled EZ grip geometry from a straight barbell. Whole body and bar.

ALTERNATING DUMBBELL CURL. Standing upright athlete. One arm is visibly curled to roughly 110 degrees at elbow, palm fully supinated, dumbbell near front shoulder; opposite arm hangs fully lowered beside hip holding other dumbbell with neutral grip. Both upper arms remain at sides, no shoulder press or leaning. Front three-quarter view clearly separates the asynchronous arms and weights; full body/shoes.

SEATED DUMBBELL CURL. Athlete seated upright on a plain flat bench with no backrest, both feet flat and knees at 90 degrees. Both elbows tucked by sides, both silver dumbbells curled at same time, palms visibly supinated, forearms above horizontal. Torso vertical without reclining. Front three-quarter view shows seated hips, flat bench, feet, both weights and underhand grips.

INCLINE DUMBBELL CURL. Athlete reclines against a black bench backrest set about 55 degrees, head/back supported, both feet flat forward. Upper arms hang down slightly BEHIND torso, elbows below shoulders; both forearms supinated and curling matching dumbbells upward without shoulder flexion. Elbows stay low next to bench and wrists face up. Side-front view exposes inclined support, stretched upper-arm position behind torso and curl bend. NOT an incline press: weights below chest/shoulders, upper arms downward, no pressing elbows.

STANDING DUMBBELL CURL. Full-length standing athlete at controlled middle-lower curl phase, upper arms vertically beside ribs, both elbows bent about 80 degrees. Both palms fully SUPINATED upward, wrists straight; separate silver dumbbells forward from hips. Feet hip width, torso upright and still. Slightly SIDE-front view makes elbow angle and quiet shoulders obvious. This exact identity overlaps generic Dumbbell Curl; do not invent a different grip or stance just to differentiate it.

SPIDER CURL using modest EZ bar. Athlete PRONE with CHEST supported on a black incline bench angled about 45 degrees, feet planted wide behind bench. Both upper arms hang straight DOWN beyond top of bench under shoulders, both elbows flex to bring EZ bar upward toward face/upper chest with underhand angled grips. Forearms are NOT resting on a preacher pad: elbows hang freely in front of bench. Side three-quarter camera shows downward upper-arm geometry, prone chest and free-hanging curl. Whole body and bench feet/bar ends.

SINGLE ARM PREACHER CURL. Athlete seated behind black preacher curl pad angled downward away from chest, ONE upper arm rests fully on pad with elbow supported near lower edge. That forearm curled upward to about 100 degrees, palm supinated, hand wrapped on one silver dumbbell. Opposite empty hand braces lightly on top edge of pad. Two feet flat, whole dedicated preacher bench and athlete. Front-side angle reveals a single working arm, supported elbow and palm-up curl; no duplicate dumbbell.

DUMBBELL PREACHER CURL, bilateral. Athlete seated at black preacher bench, BOTH upper arms lying on sloping pad, both elbows supported near lower edge. Two separate silver dumbbells in palm-up grips, both forearms curled upward about 95 degrees. Show clear space between two dumbbells and separate wrapped handles; no bar linking them. Feet planted, chest close to high edge pad. Front three-quarter view includes entire seated body, bench structure and both weights.

EZ BAR PREACHER CURL. Athlete seated with BOTH upper arms fully resting on sloped black preacher pad, elbows supported near lower edge. Both forearms curl one visibly zigzag symmetric silver EZ BAR upward using underhand angled grips, light equal plates on both sleeves. Pad supports upper arms, bar clears pad. Whole seated athlete, planted feet, bench supports and both bar ends. Front-side camera separates EZ shaft bends from pad and hands.

CONCENTRATION CURL, bilateral depiction honoring this definition's governed bilateral sidedness. Athlete seated on front edge of flat black bench, legs spread wide, torso leaned forward. BOTH elbows brace against the INNER thighs just above knees. BOTH palms supinated and forearms curl TWO separate modest silver dumbbells up between the knees; one dumbbell per hand, handles unconnected and clear separation. Elbows stay against thighs, not hanging free. Full front three-quarter view shows bilateral thigh bracing, coherent wrists and complete bench/feet. This is not a preacher curl: no arm pad.

HAMMER CURL, bilateral. Standing upright athlete, both upper arms vertical at ribs and elbows flexed 100 degrees, both hands maintain NEUTRAL thumb-up grips. Two silver dumbbells held with long axes of handles close to vertical, end discs stacked vertically with top heads pointing upward, palms facing each other. No palm-up supination. Front-side camera shows both neutral grips, vertical dumbbell heads, quiet torso and full planted shoes.

CROSS BODY HAMMER CURL, alternating phase with two dumbbells. Standing upright. Working elbow stays by side while its forearm bends DIAGONALLY ACROSS torso, bringing thumb-up neutral-grip dumbbell toward OPPOSITE pectoral/shoulder. Other arm hangs at side holding second dumbbell. Palms do not turn up, working dumbbell vertically oriented. Front view slightly three-quarter makes diagonal crossing path unmistakable, no shoulder shrug or lateral raise. Entire athlete and weights.

ZOTTMAN CURL at start of eccentric lowering after rotation. Standing stable athlete, both elbows tucked at sides and bent about 110 degrees. Both forearms have rotated to palms DOWN, overhand grips on two separate silver dumbbells in front of chest; show backs of hands facing UP toward camera and thumb wrap below handles. This pronated top/lowering phase defines Zottman versus ordinary supinated curl. Both upper arms remain down, no front raise. Front-side view, full body, no motion arrows or duplicate limbs.

DRAG CURL with straight barbell. Upright standing athlete, palms UP on light straight silver bar. Both ELBOWS pulled conspicuously BACK behind rib cage, upper arms slope backward; bar travels very close against front abdomen/lower ribs at top curl. Forearms slope up-forward from rearward elbows to bar near torso, not the forward arc of standard curl. True side three-quarter view exposes elbows behind torso and bar near abdomen. Complete bar ends, feet and athlete.

REVERSE CURL. Standing athlete with both elbows close to ribs, elbows bent around 90 degrees. Both hands use PRONATED OVERHAND grip on a perfectly straight light silver barbell: palms face floor, knuckles/bare backs of hands upward and thumbs wrapped underneath. Bar is in front waist/abdomen, elbows remain low without shoulder lift. Front elevated three-quarter view clearly exposes overhand wrists and straight bar with small symmetric plates, full body/shoes.

CHEAT CURL, controlled assisted concentric phase using straight barbell. Standing muscular athlete with feet shoulder-width and softly bent knees, hips just extending forward from a small hinge to assist a heavier-than-strict supinated barbell curl. Torso leans BACK only about 10 degrees as bar reaches mid-abdomen, elbows bent around90 degrees, shoulders below ears. Athletic mild hip drive clearly visible, no extreme lumbar arch or unsafe contortion. Side three-quarter view emphasizes hips/knees and slight rearward torso; whole body and straight symmetrically loaded bar.

DUMBBELL WRIST CURL, bilateral. Athlete seated on flat bench, torso slightly forward, both forearms resting PALMS UP lengthwise on thighs, wrists extend just past knees. Each hand holds one SMALL silver dumbbell, wrists FLEX upward toward inner forearms while forearms stay down. No elbow/biceps curl; elbow angle stays fixed. Front elevated three-quarter view makes palm-up wrists and two separate weights clearly visible, complete bench and feet.

BEHIND THE BACK WRIST CURL. Standing athlete, both arms long straight down BEHIND hips, narrow overhand grip on straight silver barbell held behind upper thighs/buttocks. Wrists FLEX so bar rises slightly behind glutes while elbows remain straight; fingers firmly closed. Rear three-quarter camera, athlete's back faces camera with face only in profile, clearly exposes bar BEHIND legs and wrists curling, both shoulders relaxed. Modest symmetric plates, full shoes and bar ends.

REVERSE WRIST CURL with light perfectly STRAIGHT barbell. Seated athlete leaning forward, BOTH forearms rest PALMS DOWN on thighs, wrists hanging beyond knees. Hands pronated, backs of hands UP; wrist EXTENSION lifts knuckles and straight silver bar upward while forearms remain on thighs. Small equal plates and a rigid unbent shaft, no EZ bar. Elevated front-side camera makes pronation and raised backs of hands obvious. Full athlete and bench.

DUMBBELL REVERSE WRIST CURL, bilateral. Seated forward on black bench, BOTH forearms supported on thighs PALMS DOWN, wrists just past knees. Two SMALL silver dumbbells in overhand grips, both wrists extend upwards so knuckles rise toward back of forearms; elbows and forearms do not lift. Elevated front three-quarter camera shows backs of both hands and two separate weighted handles. Full athlete and feet/bench, no palm-up grips.

WRIST ROLLER. Standing athlete holds a short horizontal cylindrical silver roller handle with BOTH hands overhand shoulder-width at chest height, elbows softly bent. ONE taut narrow black cord attached to roller's center winds around shaft and runs visibly DOWN to one small silver plate on a loading pin, suspended above floor between feet. Hands rotate handle via wrist flexion/extension, one wrist slightly up and other slightly down. Entire continuous cord, roller and hanging weight visible, not a cable machine or pulley. Front three-quarter camera, whole body/shoes and plate.

movements.implement: Two pairs of smooth weight plates
movements.cue: PLATE PINCH, bilateral grip hold. Standing athlete arms straight at sides, each hand PINCHES the top rim of TWO modest smooth silver weight plates pressed face-to-face. THUMB presses one outward plate face, FOUR fingers press opposite face; fingers do NOT pass through plate holes or handles. Plates hang vertically beside thighs, weight held by friction of fingertips and thumb at upper edge. Front three-quarter camera makes near-hand pinch geometry obvious; smooth plain plate outer faces, centered holes empty, two coherent plate stacks, whole body and shoes.

FAT GRIP HOLD, static bilateral grip. Standing still upright athlete with arms straight down beside hips, holding TWO silver dumbbells with conspicuously THICK matte graphite cylindrical sleeves around their handles (about 2.5-inch diameter). Hands wrap broadly around thick handles, fingers and thumb cannot meet as on thin handles. Neutral wrists, relaxed shoulders, no walking stride or shrug. Slight low front-side camera clearly exposes near-hand thick handle while keeping full figure and both dumbbells/shoes. No branding on sleeves.

BARBELL FINGER CURL, seated bilateral. Athlete seated leaning forward on black bench, BOTH forearms rest palms UP on thighs, wrists just beyond knees remain NEUTRAL without wrist flexion. Light straight silver bar lies across the curled proximal FINGER pads in a partly opened grip, rolled slightly away from palms. Fingers flex to roll shaft back toward palms while forearms remain supported. Clearly show thumbs relaxed and space between palm heels and bar, no floating bar or broken fingers. Elevated front-side camera emphasizes fingers and straight bar while full athlete/bench remain in frame. Light small symmetric plates.

movements.implement: Two short single-ended weighted lever bars
movements.cue: LEVER BAR PRONATION, bilateral synchronized representation. Seated athlete with both forearms supported horizontally on thighs, elbows near90 degrees, hands beyond knees. Each hand grips near unweighted end of one short straight leverage bar with ONE small silver disc securely collared at far end. Rotate BOTH forearms inward from neutral so palms turn DOWN and weighted tips tilt inward toward midline about45 degrees from vertical. Knuckles facing partly UP, fingers wrapped, wrists straight; two bars stop short of crossing/meeting. Elevated front view makes pronated hand orientation and two offset-weight bars clear; full seated body and bench. Not wrist flexion and not a two-ended dumbbell.

movements.implement: Two short single-ended weighted lever bars
movements.cue: LEVER BAR SUPINATION, bilateral synchronized representation. Seated athlete both forearms supported on thighs nearhorizontal, hands beyond knees. Each hand grips near bare unweighted end of ONE short straight lever bar, ONE small silver disc secured at far end. Rotate BOTH forearms OUTWARD so palms face visibly UP and weighted tips tilt OUTWARD away from center about45 degrees from vertical. Wrists stay straight, thumbs turn outward, elbows stay fixed. Front elevated camera clearly reveals palm-up grip and outward separated weighted levers, complete seated athlete/bench and both bar tips. Different from inward palm-down pronation.

movements.implement: Two short single-ended weighted lever bars
movements.cue: RADIAL DEVIATION, bilateral free-weight wrist movement. Standing side-front athlete with BOTH arms long down at sides, palms toward thighs. Each hand holds one short single-ended lever bar like a hammer with the loaded silver end projecting FORWARD on THUMB side of grip. Bend wrists toward THUMBS to lift the forward weighted ends UP to about35degrees above horizontal, upper arms/elbows remain straight and still. Strong SIDE three-quarter view exposes forward-pointing levers and thumb-side wrist hinge, full body, feet and all lever ends. Not biceps curl or forearm rotation; light realistic load.

movements.implement: Two short single-ended weighted lever bars
movements.cue: ULNAR DEVIATION, bilateral free-weight wrist movement. Standing athlete viewed from REAR three-quarter SIDE, BOTH arms long straight beside hips, palms toward thighs. Each hand grips one short single-ended lever bar whose weighted silver tip extends BEHIND body on PINKY side of grip. Bend wrists toward PINKIES to lift the rearward weighted ends backward and UP about30degrees above horizontal, with straight elbows and quiet shoulders. Whole figure, both feet and both rearward projecting levers clearly visible. This is a little-finger-side wrist hinge, NOT the forward thumb-side radial deviation and not a curl.

FRONT SQUAT, full bottom position. Athlete standing shoulder-width, both heels flat, knees deeply flexed with thighs just below parallel, torso tall. Straight silver barbell with symmetric moderate plates rests across FRONT deltoids, elbows very HIGH forward, clean fingertip front-rack grip with wrists extended beneath bar. Bar clearly ahead of neck on front shoulders, not on upper back or elbows. Side-front three-quarter camera reveals front rack, upright torso, knee/hip depth and full flat feet. No rack or machine in scene; whole bar ends.

movements.implement: Straight barbell in high back rack
movements.cue: HIGH BAR SQUAT, controlled full bottom. Straight loaded silver barbell rests HIGH on upper trapezius just below back of neck, hands grip bar outside shoulders, elbows point down/back. Both feet shoulder-width flat, knees forward/out tracking toes, hips lowered so thighs just below parallel, torso relatively upright. SIDE-rear three-quarter view clearly shows upper-back bar placement, both knees and complete feet. Do not depict low-bar forward good morning or front rack. Whole athlete and both symmetric plate stacks/bar ends.

ZERCHER SQUAT at deep bottom. Athlete squats with both feet flat shoulder-width, knees bent and thighs near/below parallel, torso upright. ONE straight silver barbell cradled across CROOKS OF BOTH ELBOWS in front of lower chest, elbows around90degrees, forearms point up with fists together. Bar rests in elbow creases, NOT hands or shoulders; continuous bar projects beyond both elbows to small equal plates. Front-side angle exposes elbow support and deep squat, full shoes/bar ends. No impossible arm/bar intersection beyond natural crook contact.

GOBLET SQUAT, deep bottom on FLAT FLOOR. Athlete feet slightly wider than hips, both heels down flat, knees tracking outward, hips low and torso upright. BOTH hands cup underneath the TOP head of one vertical silver dumbbell held close to upper chest, lower head hangs between forearms. Elbows downward inside knees, wrist grips physically coherent. Front three-quarter view shows goblet hand cup, single vertical dumbbell and deep squat on flat floor; NO heel wedges, platform or bench. Full body and shoes.

CYCLIST SQUAT with HIGH-BAR loading. Athlete narrow stance, feet close but not touching, BOTH heels visibly elevated on a single low black sloped squat wedge, toes lower on floor. Deep knee-forward squat, thighs below parallel, knees close tracking toes, torso very upright. Straight silver bar on HIGH upper back with symmetric modest plates, hands outside shoulders. Side-front view makes narrow stance, elevated heels, forward knees and bar-on-back unambiguous. Complete wedge, full feet and bar ends; not goblet squat.

HEEL ELEVATED GOBLET SQUAT at deep bottom. One silver dumbbell held VERTICAL at chest with BOTH hands cupped under top head, elbows point down inside knees. BOTH heels stand on one low stable black sloped wedge, toes lower toward floor, feet about hip-width. Knees travel forward and hips drop deeply with upright torso, thighs below parallel. Side-front camera clearly exposes heel lift/wedge and front goblet loading, full feet and weight; distinct from flat-floor goblet and back-loaded cyclist squat.

movements.implement: Two dumbbells and low front-foot platform
movements.cue: FRONT FOOT ELEVATED SPLIT SQUAT at bottom. Athlete in split stance with entire FRONT foot flat on one LOW black rectangular platform about10cm high. REAR foot stays on FLOOR behind, heel lifted and toes pressing floor, rear knee lowered close to floor. Front knee deeply bent, torso upright, TWO dumbbells hang at sides. Side three-quarter camera clearly shows FRONT-foot elevation and rear-foot floor contact; rear foot NOT on bench. Whole athlete, step, two weights and shoes.

HEEL ELEVATED SPLIT SQUAT at bottom. Split stance, FRONT HEEL rests on a small low black wedge while front TOES press lower floor, front knee tracks far forward with deep bend. REAR foot on floor behind on its toes, back heel up, rear knee lowered. Torso upright, one dumbbell held each side in straight arms. Side camera makes only front HEEL raised, not entire front foot on a box and not rear foot on a bench. Full shoes, low wedge and dumbbells visible.

REVERSE LUNGE with dumbbells, bottom of BACKWARD step. Front foot stays fully planted under athlete, same-side knee flexed near90degrees. Rear leg has stepped FAR BACK, rear forefoot grounded with heel high and rear knee just above floor. Torso tall with mild natural forward inclination, paired silver dumbbells hanging straight at sides. Side three-quarter view shows long rearward step behind hips and stable planted front foot. Two legs only, no bench/platform. Whole stance and both weights; a still represents position rather than proving travel direction.

WALKING LUNGE with paired dumbbells, transitioning FORWARD out of a stride. Front foot fully grounded, front knee still bent about60degrees supporting body rising and advancing. Rear leg trails back with heel high, only last toes touching floor about to leave; hips moving forward over planted leg. Torso tall, arms long with one silver dumbbell each side. True side three-quarter view clearly shows dynamic walking stride and trailing foot about to step through, no stationary parallel stance, no duplicated motion limbs. Full body and both shoes.

FORWARD LUNGE, controlled low position after a long forward step. Athlete facing left in side-front view, FRONT foot flat FAR AHEAD of hips, front knee about90degrees over ankle. Back knee bends and lowers close to floor with rear toes grounded/heel lifted. Upright trunk, two matching silver dumbbells at sides in straight arms, shoulders quiet. Show visible front-foot landing/forward reach stance, both complete legs/feet. No bench, no platform; no impossible airborne rear foot. Still depicts exact forward-lunge setup without motion arrows.

LATERAL LUNGE using one goblet-held dumbbell. Front camera slightly three-quarter, athlete takes very WIDE side stance: working knee bends deeply as hips sit BACK over that side, opposite leg extends long STRAIGHT sideways with foot flat. Both feet point forward, heels planted; chest up with slight hip hinge. Both hands cup top head of one vertical silver dumbbell at chest, elbows down. Lateral side-to-side geometry unmistakable, not a sagittal split squat. Full extended leg/foot, bent leg/foot and complete weight within frame.

STEP UP with paired dumbbells. Athlete near halfway up one sturdy black box about35cm tall. Working foot ENTIRELY flat on box, knee bent around60degrees bearing load; opposite leg trails down behind with its toes just lifting OFF FLOOR to step upward, not resting on box. Torso upright with modest natural lean; two silver dumbbells hang straight at sides. Side three-quarter camera shows box height, flat working sole, knee drive and trailing foot. Whole athlete, two legs only, full shoes/box/weights.

movements.implement: Two light dumbbells and low step
movements.cue: PETERSON STEP UP, loaded with two light dumbbells, small controlled single-leg knee-extension pattern. Athlete stands sideways at edge of LOW black step about10cm high. Working foot on step with HEEL SLIGHTLY RAISED to bias forefoot, working knee travels FORWARD and bends; nonworking leg extends diagonally forward off step with heel hovering just above lower FLOOR and toes lifted. Upright torso, paired light dumbbells at sides. Side-front angle clearly shows low step, forward heel-tap leg, elevated working heel and knee-over-toe, not a high box step-up. Full body and feet.

DUMBBELL STEP DOWN, controlled eccentric single-leg lowering. Athlete on ONE working foot entirely FLAT on a sturdy black step about20cm high; working knee bent and hips lowering. Opposite leg reaches forward/down from edge with its HEEL just about to touch floor, toes dorsiflexed UP. Two modest silver dumbbells held at sides, torso tall with mild hip hinge. Side-front camera shows flat supported heel, descending unsupported leg and floor heel-tap. Whole two legs/shoes and step; no elevated supporting heel as in Peterson step-up.

movements.implement: Single dumbbell plus support band and fixed anchor
movements.cue: SPANISH SQUAT WITH WEIGHT. Athlete deep seated-back squat, shins nearly VERTICAL and both feet flat shoulder-width, torso upright. Both hands goblet-hold one vertical silver dumbbell at chest. A BROAD black support strap/band passes BEHIND BOTH KNEES and runs horizontally FORWARD to one sturdy visible low anchor post bolted into floor in front of athlete; tension permits sitting hips BACK. Show side three-quarter profile exposing strap behind knee hollows, taut front anchor and dumbbell. Not band-only exercise: external handheld weight is clear. No chair under athlete, no impossible strap through legs. Full body, anchor foot and complete strap path.

ROMANIAN DEADLIFT, conventional barbell hinge bottom. Athlete stands feet hip width flat, knees softly flexed only15degrees, hips pushed BACK with neutral long flat spine and torso almost horizontal. Straight silver barbell held shoulder-width OVERHAND by straight arms, bar very close to SHINS just below knees/mid-shin and suspended ABOVE floor. Modest equal plates; not touching floor. TRUE SIDE three-quarter camera exposes hip hinge, shallow knee angle, bar close to legs and neutral head looking down-forward. No squat or rounded-back Jefferson curl; full shoes and bar ends with margin.

SINGLE LEG ROMANIAN DEADLIFT. Athlete balances on ONE planted flat foot with softly bent knee; opposite leg extends straight BACK and UP in line with near-horizontal torso, hips square to floor. TWO silver dumbbells held in straight arms hanging below shoulders near stance shin; head neutral looking down. Side three-quarter camera makes long T-shaped torso/rear-leg line and single support foot obvious. Only two anatomically coherent legs, no rear toe contact, no floating stance heel; full extended rear shoe, dumbbells and supporting foot.

B-STANCE ROMANIAN DEADLIFT. Side three-quarter full figure shows staggered kickstand stance: main working foot FLAT below hip; opposite foot only20cm back resting on toes with raised heel. Hips pushed back, both knees slightly soft, long neutral spine and torso inclined nearly horizontal. TWO silver dumbbells hang in straight arms near working shin. Rear foot remains on ground, unlike single-leg RDL. Whole feet, weights; no squat.

STIFF-LEG DEADLIFT. Athlete hip hinges with legs visibly nearly straight, knees unlocked only5degrees; feet hip-width flat. Flat neutral long back, hips high, torso near horizontal; straight silver bar in overhand shoulder-width hands just above shoe tops, close to shins, modest balanced plates hovering just off floor. Side-front angle exposes near-straight knee distinction versus softly bent Romanian deadlift, full athlete and bar ends with generous margins. No spinal rounding.

SNATCH-GRIP ROMANIAN DEADLIFT. Athlete hinge with hips back, softly bent knees, torso nearly horizontal and neutral spine. Both hands take unmistakably VERY WIDE overhand grip near inner plate collars, about1.5 shoulder-width, straight arms diagonally out to bar. Bar close to shins below knees, plates above floor. FRONT-SIDE three-quarter angle makes wide grip and hinge simultaneously clear. Straight intact bar and complete equal plates/ends inside frame.

BARBELL GOOD MORNING. Side three-quarter view: standing athlete hinges forward from hips, hips pushed far back, knees softly bent, torso almost horizontal with flat neutral spine. Straight barbell rests firmly across upper BACK/trapezius below neck, held with both hands outside shoulders, elbows angled back; no hanging bar in hands. Feet flat hip-width. Full bar plates and shoes; keep bar on upper back, no spinal overflexion.

SEATED GOOD MORNING. Athlete sits astride near end of sturdy black flat bench, hips remain clearly ON PAD, feet spread and flat on floor. He hinges torso forward between thighs until back near horizontal, neutral long spine; straight barbell on upper back behind shoulders, hands grip outside shoulders. Side-front camera shows seated pelvis/pad contact, wide knees, forward hinge and intact bar. Full bench feet, both shoes, plates and bar ends.

DUMBBELL GOOD MORNING. Standing athlete performs hip hinge: feet hip-width, softly bent knees, hips back, torso near horizontal, flat neutral spine. TWO modest silver dumbbells held securely AT SHOULDERS in a front-rack, one hand each, palms inward and elbows folded close; loads stay at shoulders throughout, NOT hanging toward shins like RDL. Side three-quarter view makes shoulder loading and hinge obvious, full body shoes and both separate dumbbells.

movements.implement: Weight plate and glute-ham developer support
movements.cue: GLUTE-HAM RAISE WITH WEIGHT. Athletic man on a simple realistic black glute-ham developer, knees on front curved cushion, feet secured between two horizontal ankle rollers at rear footplate. At mid knee-flexion raise: shins horizontal toward rear rollers, KNEES bent about60degrees, thighs HIPS TORSO form ONE STRAIGHT diagonal line rising35degrees above horizontal. Hips stay EXTENDED, no bending torso over pad as back extension. Both hands hold ONE small round silver plate flat to chest. True SIDE camera clearly exposes pivot at knees, straight thigh-to-head line and feet secured. Whole support frame and body with margin, no selector stack/cables.

movements.implement: Straight padded barbell and flat bench
movements.cue: BARBELL HIP THRUST. Side-front three-quarter view. Athlete upper back/scapulae supported across edge of sturdy black bench, both feet hip-width FLAT on floor, shins vertical. Hips lifted to form horizontal shoulder-hip-knee line, chin gently tucked, no back hyperextension. Straight barbell lies TRANSVERSE across pelvis on black hip pad; two hands stabilize bar just outside hips. Equal round silver plates at either end remain above floor. Entire bench, both feet, bar ends and realistic hip contact.

DUMBBELL HIP THRUST. Side three-quarter view of athlete upper back supported at edge of black flat bench, both feet flat, knees90degrees, hips raised into straight horizontal shoulder-hip-knee line. ONE silver dumbbell lies sideways ACROSS HIP CREASE on small protective pad, both hands firmly stabilizing its ends. Weight is at pelvis, never abdomen/chest. Complete bench feet, full shoes, neutral head and no back overextension.

movements.implement: Straight padded barbell and exercise mat
movements.cue: BARBELL GLUTE BRIDGE on FLOOR, no bench. Side-front view athlete lying with head/shoulders on thin dark mat, both feet flat close to hips, knees bent.
